Package com.elioo.healthcare.llm.model

Record Class LlmResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.elioo.healthcare.llm.model.LlmResponse
Record Components:
content - The generated text content
stopReason - Reason for stopping generation (e.g., "end_turn", "max_tokens")
usage - Token usage statistics
modelId - Model that generated the response
metadata - Additional response metadata
public record LlmResponse(String content, String stopReason, TokenUsage usage, String modelId, Map<String,Object> metadata) extends Record
Generic LLM invocation response. This model represents a domain-agnostic response from a Large Language Model via AWS Bedrock. It normalizes responses from different model providers.
